en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` sessions failing on the first 5xx or dropped connection after a run of 429/529 waits, and sleeping uncapped and silently on a long `Retry-After` from a 5xx
zh: 修复 `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` session 在一连串 429/529 等待后遇到首个 5xx 或连接断开时失败，以及遇到 5xx 返回的长 `Retry-After` 时无上限地静默休眠的问题
